channel.title: Writing by Adarsh Singh
channel.description: Notes by Adarsh Singh on backend systems, protocols, developer tooling, and the decisions behind them.

item.title: Agent, harness, interface, tools: what each one is and how much to care
item.description: An agent is a model running tools in a loop. The harness runs that loop, the interface is where you watch it. Which layer actually decides the quality.

item.title: Configuration is code that nobody tests
item.description: 1,000+ gift card brands took 30 minutes each to check by hand. A validator now checks all of them in about 30 minutes. Why config needs scheduled tests.

item.title: Why we built a backend template for developers and AI agents
item.description: A TypeScript starter that fixes the backend decisions once, so developers and coding agents can spend their time on business logic instead of conventions.

item.title: What building on ONDC taught me about the difference between an API and a protocol
item.description: No central author, callbacks instead of responses, defensive parsing — what changes when you integrate with a shared agreement instead of a service.

item.title: Async context as a mental model, not just a library
item.description: AsyncLocalStorage is really about how a value survives async boundaries — plus the rule for when context helps and when it hides real dependencies.
